tasks.title: Create Next.js middleware for Supabase auth session refresh

tasks.title: Replace in-memory rate limiter with Redis-backed implementation

acceptanceCriteria: Rate limits enforced across all function instances

tasks.title: Remove mock Supabase client fallbacks in production code paths
